subject.title: [Bug]: Concurrent chat tool runs overwrite each other's cards and hydration

question: Should the Control UI treat `(runId, toolCallId)` as the canonical live-card identity across streaming and history reconciliation, with any legacy events handled only at the boundary?
rationale: The issue describes a concrete correctness defect, but the required compatibility treatment for legacy or incomplete event envelopes cannot be safely chosen without inspecting the current UI and gateway contracts.

options.title: Adopt run-scoped identity
options.body: Use `(runId, toolCallId)` consistently and add regression coverage for concurrent same-call-ID runs and hydrated terminal results.

options.title: Preserve legacy fallback
options.body: Retain a narrowly documented fallback for envelopes without a run ID only if current protocol consumers still require it.

recommendation.title: Adopt run-scoped identity
recommendation.body: Use `(runId, toolCallId)` consistently and add regression coverage for concurrent same-call-ID runs and hydrated terminal results.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied issue and related work identify the affected Control UI surfaces, but feature-history ownership could not be verified in the unavailable read-only shell.
